name: Block IP Address for WooCommerce
author: wpcraftnet

sections.description:
The WC Block IP Address plugin allows you to restrict access to your WooCommerce shop page based on specific IP addresses. If a visitor’s IP address matches a blocked entry, they will be redirected to a custom page of your choice instead of being able to view the shop.

You can also set a start and end date for each blocked IP, enabling time-based restrictions for more flexible access control.

This plugin is ideal for:
– Blocking users temporarily or permanently based on their IP.
– Preventing unwanted traffic, spam, or bot activity.
– Securing your WooCommerce store with targeted control.

Key Features:
– Easily add & manage blocked IP addresses.
– Define block duration using start and end dates.
– Redirect blocked IPs to any page (e.g., home, contact, or a custom notice page).
– Lightweight and simple to configure.
– Compatible with the latest WooCommerce and WordPress versions.

Contacts

If you need assistance, please visit our website at wpcraft.net or contact our support team at info@wpcraft.net.
sections.faq:
Can I set a duration for blocked IPs?

Yes. You can define a start and end date for each blocked IP. The restriction will only be active within this time period.

Can I redirect blocked users to a custom page?

Yes, you can choose any page on your site for redirection.

Does this block access to the entire WooCommerce site?

No, only the shop page is restricted. Other pages remain accessible unless separately restricted.

Can I block IP ranges?

Currently, the plugin only supports individual IPs. IP range support may be added in future updates.

Does this affect site speed?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with most major caching plugins.
